reviews.text:
I'm always so grateful for their grooming services!!

They always do a fantastic job and leave my dog ​​looking adorable!!

I'm so happy to see photos of my dog ​​during grooming, as it's not something I get to see often! ✨
I recently used their pet hotel service for the first time because I had to leave Tokyo for a business trip, and it was fantastic!

They sent me so many detailed messages about how my dog ​​was doing and what he was up to during his one-night stay—enough to fill three LINE messages! It was so reassuring and heartwarming!

They showered my dog ​​with love and sent me lots of photos—from walks to playing with friends and other adorable shots—so I didn't feel lonely even though I was away!!

I'm so satisfied, I highly recommend it to everyone!
The grooming was poorly done, the staff didn't greet me, and they seemed unmotivated; it was a disappointing experience.

It seems a dog had an accident outside, and they were using a hose to spray water, which splashed onto my feet as I was on my way to work. It was extremely unpleasant. Do they think it's okay as long as they're fine?? I think it's obvious that they should turn off the water when people are passing by, without even being told.

Thank you for your kind feedback.

We will continue to strive to provide you with satisfactory service, and we appreciate your continued support.

I requested temporary boarding for my dog. I didn't know the location, so I called, and they came to pick him up.

When I finished my errands and went to pick up my dog, there were many dogs playing in a large space, watched over by many staff members, and they looked very happy. It was like a small dog park.

I thought it was the best environment for leaving a dog. Thank you to all the staff.

My child attends daycare! I recently tried their obedience training service for the first time.
The daycare always contacts me twice a day, once at lunchtime and once after picking up my child, which is reassuring. The obedience training was reasonably priced, covered everything I wanted to learn in one session, and made it easy to review at home. They didn't pressure me to buy a multi-session package, and their willingness to come back if needed was very much appreciated.

I've tried several places before, but this one is by far the best! I hope it doesn't become so popular that it becomes impossible to book an appointment! (^^) lol.
